title: 挖掘机的一天
subtitle: 栏杆里面，在造什么呢？
character: wearing a red t-shirt, denim overalls and brown boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in vintage mid-century style, cute simple rounded machines with friendly toy-like shapes, thick black outlines, flat bright colors of mustard yellow, orange, teal and black, halftone dot texture on off-white paper, clean simple background, every person has natural skin tones
facts: 用长长的手臂和铲斗挖土
把土运走，车斗一抬就倒下
把很重的东西吊到高处

pages.zh:
我家旁边围起了一圈高高的栏杆。
里面轰隆隆，轰隆隆，好热闹。
工地很危险，不能进去，
我就站在栏杆外面看。
pages.scene: The little boy stands outside a tall construction site fence, looking through a gap in the fence at big yellow machines working on the dirt inside, safe on the sidewalk.

pages.zh:
大「挖掘机」伸出长长的手臂，
大铲斗往下一挖，
就是一大块土。
pages.scene: A big simple cartoon excavator with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, digs into a pile of brown earth with its long arm, its toothed bucket full of dirt, a construction site with a fence and a crane in the distance.

pages.zh:
自卸车把土装走，
开到另一边，车斗一抬——
哗！
土就倒下来了。
pages.scene: A big simple cartoon dump truck with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, tips up its raised orange bed, and a pile of brown dirt slides out onto the ground at the construction site.

pages.zh:
推土机往前推呀推，
把高高低低的土，
推得平平的。
pages.scene: A simple cartoon bulldozer with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, pushes a mound of dirt forward with its wide flat blade, leaving flat smooth ground behind it.

pages.zh:
水泥搅拌车的大肚子，
一直转呀转。
里面的水泥一停下来，
就会变硬啦。
pages.scene: A simple cartoon cement mixer truck with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, its big striped drum turning, pours grey wet concrete down a chute at the construction site.

pages.zh:
高高的塔吊站在工地中间，
它把长长的钢筋，
一下子吊到了半空中。
pages.scene: A tall simple cartoon tower crane with chunky shapes stands in the middle of the construction site, a grown-up operator in a yellow hard hat in its small cab high up, lifting a bundle of long steel beams into the blue sky on its cable.

pages.zh:
工人叔叔都戴着黄色的安全帽。
他们看着图纸，
告诉每一辆车该做什么。
pages.scene: Construction workers in yellow hard hats and orange vests stand together at the site, one of them pointing at a big rolled-out plan, simple cartoon machines behind them.

pages.zh:
压路机慢慢地压过去，
新铺的路，
变得又平又光。
pages.scene: A simple cartoon road roller with chunky rounded shapes, a grown-up driver in a yellow hard hat sitting inside its cab, slowly rolls its big smooth drum over a freshly paved dark path, making it flat and shiny.

pages.zh:
过了好多好多天，
栏杆拆掉了——
原来他们造的是一个新的游乐场！
pages.scene: The fence is gone and a brand new playground stands where the construction site was, with a slide, swings and a sandbox. The little boy runs toward it happily.

pages.zh:
我在沙坑里，
开着我的小挖掘机。
挖一挖，推一推，
我也在造房子呢！
pages.scene: The little boy kneels in a sandbox playing with a toy yellow excavator, digging a small hole and building a little mound of sand, sunny playground around him.
